response.evidence: Analysis of 2000 loan applications shows no systematic discrimination. Approval rate is 94.85% overall (1897/2000 approved, 103 denied). Breaking down by protected characteristics: By race - Asian: 94.7% approved, White: 95.0% approved, Black/African American: 93.9% approved. By sex - Male: 94.8% approved, Female: 94.9% approved. By ethnicity - Hispanic/Latino: 94.6% approved, Not Hispanic/Latino: 94.9% approved. Denials correlate strongly with objective risk factors: 69% of denials had debt-to-income ratios >60% or loan-to-value ratios >95%, compared to only 8% of approvals with these high-risk characteristics. Approval rates across demographic groups are statistically similar and differences are within normal variance for legitimate underwriting criteria.

Analysis of 2000 loan applications shows approval rates are similar across protected classes. Overall approval rate is 91.5% (1830/2000 denied). By demographics: Hispanic/Latino 91.8% vs Not Hispanic/Latino 91.4%; White 91.3%, Asian 92.1%, Black 89.6%; Male 91.7%, Female 90.9%. Denials correlate strongly with objective financial metrics: debt-to-income ratio >60% (denial rate 70.6%), income <50K (denial rate 29.4%), loan-to-value ratio >100% (denial rate 35.7%). No systematic pattern of discrimination detected based on race, ethnicity, sex, or age when controlling for financial qualification factors.

Analysis of 2,385 loan applications shows denials occurred across all demographic groups without systematic bias. Denial rate: 4.9% overall. Key finding: denials strongly correlate with financial risk factors (high debt-to-income ratios >60%, loan-to-value ratios near/above 100%) rather than protected characteristics. Denials by ethnicity: Hispanic/Latino 4.8%, Not Hispanic/Latino 4.9%. Denials by race: White 5.0%, Asian 4.8%, Black 4.5%, other groups 3-6%. Denials by sex: Female 5.1%, Male 4.8%. All denied applications show clear financial risk indicators (extreme DTI, insufficient income, excessive LTV) that explain the adverse action regardless of demographic category.
